premises.text: Multichannel selling lifts sales but is tedious because merchants must replicate listings, orders, and inventory tracking across platforms without central real-time sync
premises.evidence_span: Multichannel selling can be tedious, time-consuming, and extremely difficult to manage in real time

premises.text: A centralized dashboard lets merchants sell, track, and manage inventory across channels with real-time multi-directional product sync and selective customization for small businesses
premises.evidence_span: The Syncommerce centralized dashboard allows online merchants to sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously

premises.text: Monthly subscription tiers from $40 to $200 based on products listed and channels connected, with integrations including Shopify, eBay, Etsy, and newly Amazon
premises.evidence_span: Our monthly subscription ranges from $40 to $200 per month

value.text: Online merchants sell more across channels while working less on inventory and listings

causal_links.evidence_span: cross-platform selling for online merchants time and capital intensive
effective and efficient multichannel retailing for online merchants a reality
affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses

notes: Pain facets (switching platforms, replicating listings/orders/inventory) folded as one multichannel burden. Dashboard publish/sync/customize features folded as one mechanism versus competitors. Pricing and channel integrations kept as commercial package for the same offer (v1.3.1 price+structure). Revenue/merchant traction excluded. 190% lift treated as demand framing inside pain/value, not separate premise.
